text:
sophia: Heads-up — onboarding request for a community checkpoint: 'falcon-lite' v1. We have weights + tokenizer but packaging is nonstandard. Goal: get provenance verified and artifact into the registry before we run quantization experiments and evals. s3 path and checksum below, license looks permissive but no training logs.
leo: can you paste the manifest + checksum here? who is the contact / COC on the repo?
sophia: manifest snippet:
```
name: falcon-lite
version: v1
weights: s3://research-bucket/falcon-lite/v1/weights.pt
tokenizer: s3://research-bucket/falcon-lite/v1/tokenizer.model
sha256: b1a2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
license: MIT-like (vendor provided)
training_logs: null
provenance_notes: vendor checkpoint, no logs attached
```
repo: https://github.com/thirdparty/falcon-lite-model
contact: @external_contributor (on GH)

amanda: infra notes — we'll need a signed s3 url or transfer to our ingest bucket. Use this command to register once copied:
```
redwood-registry upload --source s3://ingest-bucket/falcon-lite/v1 --model falcon-lite --version v1 --checksum b1a2...ef0 --meta license=MIT-like provenance=vendor_checkpoint
```
Also confirm export control / EAR status before accepting.

ciara-bot: [automated-scan] quick scan results:
- file_size: 26.1GB
- weights_format: pytorch
- tokenizer: sentencepiece
- vocab_size: 50288
- sha256_match: pending(copy)
- training_logs_present: false
- likely_provenance: third-party checkpoint (no training metadata)

ryan: If provenance is incomplete we require an elevated review. Proposed gating: we allow sandboxed evals and quant trials but block production registration until one of:
- training logs + reproducible recipe provided OR
- signed attestation from contributor OR
- internal whitelist exception approved by InfoSec.
devon: Intake checklist I suggest we follow for this thread:
1) Verify license & export control (legal)
2) Obtain signed URL and copy to ingest-bucket
3) Recalculate SHA256 after copy and compare to submitted checksum
4) Run tokenizer smoke tests: `encode->decode` roundtrip on 1000 samples
5) Run lightweight quality checks: perplexity vs baseline, toxicity quick-scan, hallucination probes
6) Run quantization experiments (4-bit & 8-bit) in isolated job; capture latency/cost tradeoffs
7) Store metadata in registry: fields = {source_repo, contributor, training_logs_flag, checksum, scan_report, eval_metrics}
8) If provenance missing, flag model for "manual provenance review" and restrict routes to dev/dedicated sandbox only

I'll open the intake ticket and assign owners for each step.

sophia: awesome — creating ticket IR-3421 and cc'ing @devon @amanda @leo. I'll also request a signed URL from the contributor and put it in the ticket. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: [registry] copy job created -> job_id=rgc-78321; status=queued; src=s3://research-bucket/falcon-lite/v1; dst=s3://ingest-bucket/falcon-lite/v1

amanda: when copy completes I will run sha256 and trigger `ciara-bot` full scan. Leave quant infra to @devon to schedule.
devon: confirmed — will schedule quant trials in sandbox and attach config to IR-3421. If anything looks off on the scan or SHA mismatch we hold.

sophia: thanks everyone, will update ticket as I get the signed URL.
